from typing import Any, assert_type
from phoenix_channels_python_client import (
    Channel, Client, Message, Payload, ProtocolVersion, Reply,
)
client = Client('ws://localhost/socket', api_key=None, protocol_version=ProtocolVersion.V2)
assert_type(client, Client)
room = client.channel('room:1', params=lambda: {'token': 'fresh'})
assert_type(room, Channel)
@room.on('event')
async def on_event(payload: Payload) -> None:
    if isinstance(payload, bytes):
        assert_type(payload, bytes)
    else:
        assert_type(payload, dict[str, Any])
async def scoped() -> None:
    async with room:
        reply = await room.push('event', {'value': 1}, timeout_s=5.0)
        assert_type(reply, Reply)
        assert_type(reply.status, str)
        assert_type(reply.response, Payload)
        binary_reply = await room.push('update', b'\x0a\x05hello')
        assert_type(binary_reply, Reply)
        if isinstance(binary_reply.response, bytes):
            assert_type(binary_reply.response, bytes)
        else:
            assert_type(binary_reply.response, dict[str, Any])
assert_type(client.channel_socket_url, str)
assert_type(ProtocolVersion.V2.vsn, str)
def receive(message: Message) -> str:
    return message.topic
async def stop() -> None:
    await client.shutdown()
